label: common_2050_top_01
text: So this is the dorm room where you live.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2050_top_02
text: I wonder, is this room what helped nurture your\npotential as a Champion?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2050_top_03
text: Ah, wait, I remember now. You only recently\nmoved into the dormitories.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2050_top_04
text: In the near future, perhaps I’ll pay your family’s\nhome a visit, if I may...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2050_top_05
text: Anyway, let us get to the topic at hand.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2050_top_06
text: I would very much like to hear your report now\nthat you’ve inspected the Gym Leaders.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2050_top_07
text: Tell me... Which Gym Leader did you feel was\nthe easiest to face in battle?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2050_top_08
text: Next, which Gym Leader left the strongest\nimpression on you?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2050_top_09
text: Then...which Gym Leader gave you the most\ntrouble during battle?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2050_top_10
text: Next is the last, most important question.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2050_top_11
text: Which Gym Leader did you like the most?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2050_top_12
text: Those are all the questions I have. Thank you\nvery much for your help on this.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2050_top_13
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Your perspective was fascinating,\nChampion [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2050_top_14
text: I have no doubt it will assist me when running\nthe organization. Please accept this as thanks.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2050_top_15
text: Thanks to you, my schedule has cleared up\nquite significantly...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2050_top_16
text: So I will most definitely be joining the\ntournament we discussed in the director’s office.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2050_top_17
text: I’m sure Champion Nemona will be pleased, too.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2050_top_18
text: Well, thanks for letting me visit. I should get\nback to work now.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2050_top_19
text: You must be tired. I suggest you take it easy\nfor the rest of the day.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
